<style id="nx-vimeo-inline-css">

.nx-vimeo-facade{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;cursor:pointer;
  background:#15003B center/cover no-repeat;border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden}
.nx-vimeo-facade .nx-vimeo-play {
	position: absolute;
	inset: 0;
	margin: auto;
	width: 92px;
	height: 54px;
	border-radius: 72px;
	background: rgba(140, 245, 133, .92);
	transition: .2s ease;
}
.nx-vimeo-facade:hover .nx-vimeo-play{background:#8CF585;}
.nx-vimeo-facade .nx-vimeo-play::before {
	content: "";
	position: absolute;
	inset: 0;
	margin: auto;
	width: 0;
	height: 0;
	border-style: solid;
	border-width: 12px 0px 12px 22px;
	border-color: transparent transparent transparent #15003B;
	transform: translateX(15%);
	transition: .2s ease;
}
.nx-vimeo-facade:hover .nx-vimeo-play::before {border-left-color:var(--e-global-color-accent);}
.nx-vimeo-facade iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0}
.nx-vimeo-facade:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #8CF585;outline-offset:2px}

/*# sourceURL=nx-vimeo-inline-css */
</style>

<style id="wp-custom-css">
/* Shared Carousel Button Styles */
.nx-btn {
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  cursor: pointer;

  /* default state */
  background: transparent;
  border: 2px solid #8ef585;
  color: #fff; /* arrow is white */
  transition: background .2s ease, color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease, transform .15s ease;
}

/* hover state */
.nx-btn:hover,
.nx-btn:focus-visible {
  background: #8ef585;
  border-color: #8ef585;
  color: #fff; /* arrow stays white */
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.nx-btn:active {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

/* smaller buttons on mobile */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .nx-btn { width: 44px; height: 44px; }
  .nx-btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
}


.nx-scope .nx-carousel,
.nx-scope .nxv-carousel{position:relative;max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;overflow:hidden}
.nx-scope .nx-track,
.nx-scope .nxv-track{display:flex;transition:transform .4s ease;will-change:transform}
.nx-scope .nx-slide,
.nx-scope .nxv-slide{flex:0 0 100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
.nx-scope .nx-media,
.nx-scope .nxv-media{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;display:block;background:#000}
.nx-scope .nx-caption,
.nx-scope .nxv-caption{margin-top:12px;color:#000;font:italic 400 18px/1.35 system-ui;text-align:center}
.nx-scope .nx-controls,
.nx-scope .nxv-controls{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:14px;margin-top:22px}

/* Copy block */
.nx-scope .nx-copy{font-size:22px;line-height:1.5;color:#fff;font-family:system-ui,Arial,sans-serif}
.nx-scope .nx-copy p{margin:0 0 28px}
.nx-scope .nx-copy .nx-green{color:#8ef585;font-weight:700;font-size:25px}

/* Grids */
.nx-scope .align-edges{max-width:1200px;margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:0;box-sizing:border-box}
.nx-scope .card-grid{display:grid;gap:40px;justify-content:center}
.nx-scope .card{
  position:relative;width:125px;height:125px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid #738291;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
  transition:transform .25s, box-shadow .25s, border-color .25s, background .25s;
}
.nx-scope .card img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .3s}
.nx-scope .card:hover,.nx-scope .card:focus-visible{
  transform:translateY(-6px) scale(1.02);box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.2);border-color:#607084;outline:none
}
.nx-scope .card:hover img,.nx-scope .card:focus-visible img{transform:scale(1.05)}
.nx-scope .card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:#8ef585;opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s;pointer-events:none}
.nx-scope .card:hover::after{opacity:.08}
.nx-scope .card.selected::after{opacity:.22}
.nx-scope .card-label{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:#eefce2;color:#000;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;
  text-align:center;padding:8px 10px;line-height:1.2;z-index:1
}
.nx-scope .card.selected .card-label{background:#8ef585}

/* 8-card (4×2) */
.nx-scope .card-grid--8{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,125px)}
@media (max-width:700px){.nx-scope .card-grid--8{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px}.nx-scope #featuredGrid .card{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1/1}}

/* 12-card (3×4) + bigger spacing request */
.nx-scope #sportsGrid12.card-grid{gap:60px}
.nx-scope .card-grid--12{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,125px)}
@media (max-width:1000px){.nx-scope .card-grid--12{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,125px)}.nx-scope #sportsGrid12.card-grid{gap:48px}}
@media (max-width:700px){.nx-scope .card-grid--12{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.nx-scope #sportsGrid12.card-grid{gap:28px}.nx-scope #sportsGrid12 .card{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1/1}}

/* 4-card (2×2) */
.nx-scope .card-grid--4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,125px)}
@media (max-width:700px){.nx-scope .card-grid--4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px}}

/* Duo layout (optional side-by-side carousels) */
.nx-scope .nx-duo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px;align-items:start}
@media (max-width:900px){.nx-scope .nx-duo{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* Global: make all tappable tiles reliable on mobile */
.card[role="button"] {
  cursor: pointer;
  pointer-events: auto;
  touch-action: manipulation;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}
.card[role="button"] * {
  pointer-events: none;       /* children won't steal the tap */
  user-select: none;
}
.card[role="button"]:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #8ef585;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
/* Allow real links/buttons inside a card to be clickable */
.card[role="button"] a,
.card[role="button"] button {
  pointer-events: auto;
}

					const lazyloadRunObserver = () => {
						const lazyloadBackgrounds = document.querySelectorAll( `.e-con.e-parent:not(.e-lazyloaded)` );
						const lazyloadBackgroundObserver = new IntersectionObserver( ( entries ) => {
							entries.forEach( ( entry ) => {
								if ( entry.isIntersecting ) {
									let lazyloadBackground = entry.target;
									if( lazyloadBackground ) {
										lazyloadBackground.classList.add( 'e-lazyloaded' );
									}
									lazyloadBackgroundObserver.unobserve( entry.target );
								}
							});
						}, { rootMargin: '200px 0px 200px 0px' } );
						lazyloadBackgrounds.forEach( ( lazyloadBackground ) => {
							lazyloadBackgroundObserver.observe( lazyloadBackground );
						} );
					};
					const events = [
						'DOMContentLoaded',
						'elementor/lazyload/observe',
					];
					events.forEach( ( event ) => {
						document.addEventListener( event, lazyloadRunObserver );
					} );
				} )();

<script id="nx-vimeo-js-after">
(function(){
  function load(f){
    if(f.dataset.nxLoaded){return;} f.dataset.nxLoaded="1";
    var id=f.dataset.vimeoId, h=f.dataset.vimeoH;
    var src="https://player.vimeo.com/video/"+id+"?autoplay=1&dnt=1"+(h?"&h="+h:"");
    f.innerHTML='<iframe src="'+src+'" data-ot-ignore allow="autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture" '+
      'allowfullscreen title="Vimeo video"></iframe>';
  }
  document.addEventListener("click",function(e){
    var f=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest(".nx-vimeo-facade");
    if(f){load(f);}
  });
  document.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){
    if(e.key!=="Enter"&&e.key!==" "){return;}
    var f=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest(".nx-vimeo-facade");
    if(f){e.preventDefault();load(f);}
  });

  /* Vimeo lightbox triggers (Swiper "video-popup" cards): force dnt=1 so the
     popup player sets no tracking cookies. The widget reads data-video-url at
     click time, so this capture-phase listener rewrites it first. */
  function nxDntUrl(u){
    if(!u||u.indexOf("player.vimeo.com")===-1||u.indexOf("dnt=1")>-1){return u;}
    u=u.replace(/\?+$/,"");
    return u+(u.indexOf("?")===-1?"?":"&")+"dnt=1";
  }
  function nxDntOne(b){
    var u=b.getAttribute("data-video-url"), n=nxDntUrl(u);
    if(n!==u){b.setAttribute("data-video-url",n);}
  }
  document.addEventListener("click",function(e){
    var b=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest(".video-popup-trigger");
    if(b){nxDntOne(b);}
  },true); /* capture phase: runs before the widget own click handler */
  function nxDntAll(){
    var t=document.querySelectorAll(".video-popup-trigger");
    for(var i=0;i<t.length;i++){nxDntOne(t[i]);}
    var fr=document.querySelectorAll(".video-popup-frame");
    for(var j=0;j<fr.length;j++){fr[j].setAttribute("data-ot-ignore","");}
  }
  if(document.readyState==="loading"){
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",nxDntAll);
  }else{nxDntAll();}
})();

//# sourceURL=nx-vimeo-js-after

<style id="wp-custom-css">
/* Shared Carousel Button Styles */
.nx-btn {
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  cursor: pointer;

  /* default state */
  background: transparent;
  border: 2px solid #8ef585;
  color: #fff; /* arrow is white */
  transition: background .2s ease, color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease, transform .15s ease;
}

/* hover state */
.nx-btn:hover,
.nx-btn:focus-visible {
  background: #8ef585;
  border-color: #8ef585;
  color: #fff; /* arrow stays white */
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.nx-btn:active {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

/* smaller buttons on mobile */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .nx-btn { width: 44px; height: 44px; }
  .nx-btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
}


.nx-scope .nx-carousel,
.nx-scope .nxv-carousel{position:relative;max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;overflow:hidden}
.nx-scope .nx-track,
.nx-scope .nxv-track{display:flex;transition:transform .4s ease;will-change:transform}
.nx-scope .nx-slide,
.nx-scope .nxv-slide{flex:0 0 100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
.nx-scope .nx-media,
.nx-scope .nxv-media{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;display:block;background:#000}
.nx-scope .nx-caption,
.nx-scope .nxv-caption{margin-top:12px;color:#000;font:italic 400 18px/1.35 system-ui;text-align:center}
.nx-scope .nx-controls,
.nx-scope .nxv-controls{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:14px;margin-top:22px}

/* Copy block */
.nx-scope .nx-copy{font-size:22px;line-height:1.5;color:#fff;font-family:system-ui,Arial,sans-serif}
.nx-scope .nx-copy p{margin:0 0 28px}
.nx-scope .nx-copy .nx-green{color:#8ef585;font-weight:700;font-size:25px}

/* Grids */
.nx-scope .align-edges{max-width:1200px;margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:0;box-sizing:border-box}
.nx-scope .card-grid{display:grid;gap:40px;justify-content:center}
.nx-scope .card{
  position:relative;width:125px;height:125px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid #738291;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
  transition:transform .25s, box-shadow .25s, border-color .25s, background .25s;
}
.nx-scope .card img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .3s}
.nx-scope .card:hover,.nx-scope .card:focus-visible{
  transform:translateY(-6px) scale(1.02);box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.2);border-color:#607084;outline:none
}
.nx-scope .card:hover img,.nx-scope .card:focus-visible img{transform:scale(1.05)}
.nx-scope .card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:#8ef585;opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s;pointer-events:none}
.nx-scope .card:hover::after{opacity:.08}
.nx-scope .card.selected::after{opacity:.22}
.nx-scope .card-label{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:#eefce2;color:#000;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;
  text-align:center;padding:8px 10px;line-height:1.2;z-index:1
}
.nx-scope .card.selected .card-label{background:#8ef585}

/* 8-card (4×2) */
.nx-scope .card-grid--8{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,125px)}
@media (max-width:700px){.nx-scope .card-grid--8{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px}.nx-scope #featuredGrid .card{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1/1}}

/* 12-card (3×4) + bigger spacing request */
.nx-scope #sportsGrid12.card-grid{gap:60px}
.nx-scope .card-grid--12{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,125px)}
@media (max-width:1000px){.nx-scope .card-grid--12{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,125px)}.nx-scope #sportsGrid12.card-grid{gap:48px}}
@media (max-width:700px){.nx-scope .card-grid--12{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.nx-scope #sportsGrid12.card-grid{gap:28px}.nx-scope #sportsGrid12 .card{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1/1}}

/* 4-card (2×2) */
.nx-scope .card-grid--4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,125px)}
@media (max-width:700px){.nx-scope .card-grid--4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px}}

/* Duo layout (optional side-by-side carousels) */
.nx-scope .nx-duo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px;align-items:start}
@media (max-width:900px){.nx-scope .nx-duo{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* Global: make all tappable tiles reliable on mobile */
.card[role="button"] {
  cursor: pointer;
  pointer-events: auto;
  touch-action: manipulation;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}
.card[role="button"] * {
  pointer-events: none;       /* children won't steal the tap */
  user-select: none;
}
.card[role="button"]:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #8ef585;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
/* Allow real links/buttons inside a card to be clickable */
.card[role="button"] a,
.card[role="button"] button {
  pointer-events: auto;
}

<style id="wp-custom-css">
/* Shared Carousel Button Styles */
.nx-btn {
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  cursor: pointer;

  /* default state */
  background: transparent;
  border: 2px solid #8ef585;
  color: #fff; /* arrow is white */
  transition: background .2s ease, color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease, transform .15s ease;
}

/* hover state */
.nx-btn:hover,
.nx-btn:focus-visible {
  background: #8ef585;
  border-color: #8ef585;
  color: #fff; /* arrow stays white */
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.nx-btn:active {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

/* smaller buttons on mobile */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .nx-btn { width: 44px; height: 44px; }
  .nx-btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
}


.nx-scope .nx-carousel,
.nx-scope .nxv-carousel{position:relative;max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;overflow:hidden}
.nx-scope .nx-track,
.nx-scope .nxv-track{display:flex;transition:transform .4s ease;will-change:transform}
.nx-scope .nx-slide,
.nx-scope .nxv-slide{flex:0 0 100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
.nx-scope .nx-media,
.nx-scope .nxv-media{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;display:block;background:#000}
.nx-scope .nx-caption,
.nx-scope .nxv-caption{margin-top:12px;color:#000;font:italic 400 18px/1.35 system-ui;text-align:center}
.nx-scope .nx-controls,
.nx-scope .nxv-controls{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:14px;margin-top:22px}

/* Copy block */
.nx-scope .nx-copy{font-size:22px;line-height:1.5;color:#fff;font-family:system-ui,Arial,sans-serif}
.nx-scope .nx-copy p{margin:0 0 28px}
.nx-scope .nx-copy .nx-green{color:#8ef585;font-weight:700;font-size:25px}

/* Grids */
.nx-scope .align-edges{max-width:1200px;margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:0;box-sizing:border-box}
.nx-scope .card-grid{display:grid;gap:40px;justify-content:center}
.nx-scope .card{
  position:relative;width:125px;height:125px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid #738291;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
  transition:transform .25s, box-shadow .25s, border-color .25s, background .25s;
}
.nx-scope .card img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .3s}
.nx-scope .card:hover,.nx-scope .card:focus-visible{
  transform:translateY(-6px) scale(1.02);box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.2);border-color:#607084;outline:none
}
.nx-scope .card:hover img,.nx-scope .card:focus-visible img{transform:scale(1.05)}
.nx-scope .card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:#8ef585;opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s;pointer-events:none}
.nx-scope .card:hover::after{opacity:.08}
.nx-scope .card.selected::after{opacity:.22}
.nx-scope .card-label{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:#eefce2;color:#000;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;
  text-align:center;padding:8px 10px;line-height:1.2;z-index:1
}
.nx-scope .card.selected .card-label{background:#8ef585}

/* 8-card (4×2) */
.nx-scope .card-grid--8{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,125px)}
@media (max-width:700px){.nx-scope .card-grid--8{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px}.nx-scope #featuredGrid .card{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1/1}}

/* 12-card (3×4) + bigger spacing request */
.nx-scope #sportsGrid12.card-grid{gap:60px}
.nx-scope .card-grid--12{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,125px)}
@media (max-width:1000px){.nx-scope .card-grid--12{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,125px)}.nx-scope #sportsGrid12.card-grid{gap:48px}}
@media (max-width:700px){.nx-scope .card-grid--12{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.nx-scope #sportsGrid12.card-grid{gap:28px}.nx-scope #sportsGrid12 .card{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1/1}}

/* 4-card (2×2) */
.nx-scope .card-grid--4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,125px)}
@media (max-width:700px){.nx-scope .card-grid--4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px}}

/* Duo layout (optional side-by-side carousels) */
.nx-scope .nx-duo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px;align-items:start}
@media (max-width:900px){.nx-scope .nx-duo{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* Global: make all tappable tiles reliable on mobile */
.card[role="button"] {
  cursor: pointer;
  pointer-events: auto;
  touch-action: manipulation;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}
.card[role="button"] * {
  pointer-events: none;       /* children won't steal the tap */

.card[role="button"]:focus-visible {

  outline-offset: 2px;
}
/* Allow real links/buttons inside a card to be clickable */
.card[role="button"] a,
.card[role="button"] button {
  pointer-events: auto;

<style id="wp-custom-css">
/* Shared Carousel Button Styles */
.nx-btn {
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  cursor: pointer;

  /* default state */
  background: transparent;
  border: 2px solid #8ef585;
  color: #fff; /* arrow is white */
  transition: background .2s ease, color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease, transform .15s ease;
}

/* hover state */
.nx-btn:hover,
.nx-btn:focus-visible {
  background: #8ef585;
  border-color: #8ef585;
  color: #fff; /* arrow stays white */
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.nx-btn:active {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

/* smaller buttons on mobile */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .nx-btn { width: 44px; height: 44px; }
  .nx-btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
}


.nx-scope .nx-carousel,
.nx-scope .nxv-carousel{position:relative;max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;overflow:hidden}
.nx-scope .nx-track,
.nx-scope .nxv-track{display:flex;transition:transform .4s ease;will-change:transform}
.nx-scope .nx-slide,
.nx-scope .nxv-slide{flex:0 0 100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
.nx-scope .nx-media,
.nx-scope .nxv-media{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;display:block;background:#000}
.nx-scope .nx-caption,
.nx-scope .nxv-caption{margin-top:12px;color:#000;font:italic 400 18px/1.35 system-ui;text-align:center}
.nx-scope .nx-controls,
.nx-scope .nxv-controls{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:14px;margin-top:22px}

/* Copy block */
.nx-scope .nx-copy{font-size:22px;line-height:1.5;color:#fff;font-family:system-ui,Arial,sans-serif}
.nx-scope .nx-copy p{margin:0 0 28px}
.nx-scope .nx-copy .nx-green{color:#8ef585;font-weight:700;font-size:25px}

/* Grids */
.nx-scope .align-edges{max-width:1200px;margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:0;box-sizing:border-box}
.nx-scope .card-grid{display:grid;gap:40px;justify-content:center}
.nx-scope .card{
  position:relative;width:125px;height:125px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid #738291;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
  transition:transform .25s, box-shadow .25s, border-color .25s, background .25s;
}
.nx-scope .card img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .3s}
.nx-scope .card:hover,.nx-scope .card:focus-visible{
  transform:translateY(-6px) scale(1.02);box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.2);border-color:#607084;outline:none
}
.nx-scope .card:hover img,.nx-scope .card:focus-visible img{transform:scale(1.05)}
.nx-scope .card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:#8ef585;opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s;pointer-events:none}
.nx-scope .card:hover::after{opacity:.08}
.nx-scope .card.selected::after{opacity:.22}
.nx-scope .card-label{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:#eefce2;color:#000;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;
  text-align:center;padding:8px 10px;line-height:1.2;z-index:1
}
.nx-scope .card.selected .card-label{background:#8ef585}

/* 8-card (4×2) */
.nx-scope .card-grid--8{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,125px)}
@media (max-width:700px){.nx-scope .card-grid--8{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px}.nx-scope #featuredGrid .card{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1/1}}

/* 12-card (3×4) + bigger spacing request */
.nx-scope #sportsGrid12.card-grid{gap:60px}
.nx-scope .card-grid--12{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,125px)}
@media (max-width:1000px){.nx-scope .card-grid--12{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,125px)}.nx-scope #sportsGrid12.card-grid{gap:48px}}
@media (max-width:700px){.nx-scope .card-grid--12{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.nx-scope #sportsGrid12.card-grid{gap:28px}.nx-scope #sportsGrid12 .card{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1/1}}

/* 4-card (2×2) */
.nx-scope .card-grid--4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,125px)}
@media (max-width:700px){.nx-scope .card-grid--4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px}}

/* Duo layout (optional side-by-side carousels) */
.nx-scope .nx-duo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px;align-items:start}
@media (max-width:900px){.nx-scope .nx-duo{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* Global: make all tappable tiles reliable on mobile */
.card[role="button"] {
  cursor: pointer;
  pointer-events: auto;
  touch-action: manipulation;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}
.card[role="button"] * {
  pointer-events: none;       /* children won't steal the tap */
  user-select: none;
}
.card[role="button"]:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #8ef585;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
/* Allow real links/buttons inside a card to be clickable */
.card[role="button"] a,
.card[role="button"] button {
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.nx-vimeo-facade{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;cursor:pointer;

.nx-vimeo-facade .nx-vimeo-play {
	position: absolute;
	inset: 0;
	margin: auto;
	width: 92px;
	height: 54px;
	border-radius: 72px;
	background: rgba(140, 245, 133, .92);
	transition: .2s ease;
}
.nx-vimeo-facade:hover .nx-vimeo-play{background:#8CF585;}
.nx-vimeo-facade .nx-vimeo-play::before {
	content: "";
	position: absolute;
	inset: 0;
	margin: auto;
	width: 0;
	height: 0;
	border-style: solid;
	border-width: 12px 0px 12px 22px;
	border-color: transparent transparent transparent #15003B;
	transform: translateX(15%);
	transition: .2s ease;
}
.nx-vimeo-facade:hover .nx-vimeo-play::before {border-left-color:var(--e-global-color-accent);}
.nx-vimeo-facade iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0}

<style id="wp-custom-css">
/* Shared Carousel Button Styles */
.nx-btn {
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  cursor: pointer;

  /* default state */
  background: transparent;
  border: 2px solid #8ef585;
  color: #fff; /* arrow is white */
  transition: background .2s ease, color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease, transform .15s ease;
}

/* hover state */
.nx-btn:hover,
.nx-btn:focus-visible {
  background: #8ef585;
  border-color: #8ef585;
  color: #fff; /* arrow stays white */
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.nx-btn:active {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

/* smaller buttons on mobile */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .nx-btn { width: 44px; height: 44px; }
  .nx-btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
}


.nx-scope .nx-carousel,
.nx-scope .nxv-carousel{position:relative;max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;overflow:hidden}
.nx-scope .nx-track,
.nx-scope .nxv-track{display:flex;transition:transform .4s ease;will-change:transform}
.nx-scope .nx-slide,
.nx-scope .nxv-slide{flex:0 0 100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
.nx-scope .nx-media,
.nx-scope .nxv-media{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;display:block;background:#000}
.nx-scope .nx-caption,
.nx-scope .nxv-caption{margin-top:12px;color:#000;font:italic 400 18px/1.35 system-ui;text-align:center}
.nx-scope .nx-controls,
.nx-scope .nxv-controls{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:14px;margin-top:22px}

/* Copy block */
.nx-scope .nx-copy{font-size:22px;line-height:1.5;color:#fff;font-family:system-ui,Arial,sans-serif}
.nx-scope .nx-copy p{margin:0 0 28px}
.nx-scope .nx-copy .nx-green{color:#8ef585;font-weight:700;font-size:25px}

/* Grids */
.nx-scope .align-edges{max-width:1200px;margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:0;box-sizing:border-box}
.nx-scope .card-grid{display:grid;gap:40px;justify-content:center}
.nx-scope .card{
  position:relative;width:125px;height:125px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid #738291;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
  transition:transform .25s, box-shadow .25s, border-color .25s, background .25s;
}
.nx-scope .card img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .3s}
.nx-scope .card:hover,.nx-scope .card:focus-visible{
  transform:translateY(-6px) scale(1.02);box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.2);border-color:#607084;outline:none
}
.nx-scope .card:hover img,.nx-scope .card:focus-visible img{transform:scale(1.05)}
.nx-scope .card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:#8ef585;opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s;pointer-events:none}
.nx-scope .card:hover::after{opacity:.08}
.nx-scope .card.selected::after{opacity:.22}
.nx-scope .card-label{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:#eefce2;color:#000;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;
  text-align:center;padding:8px 10px;line-height:1.2;z-index:1
}
.nx-scope .card.selected .card-label{background:#8ef585}

/* 8-card (4×2) */
.nx-scope .card-grid--8{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,125px)}
@media (max-width:700px){.nx-scope .card-grid--8{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px}.nx-scope #featuredGrid .card{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1/1}}

/* 12-card (3×4) + bigger spacing request */
.nx-scope #sportsGrid12.card-grid{gap:60px}
.nx-scope .card-grid--12{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,125px)}
@media (max-width:1000px){.nx-scope .card-grid--12{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,125px)}.nx-scope #sportsGrid12.card-grid{gap:48px}}
@media (max-width:700px){.nx-scope .card-grid--12{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.nx-scope #sportsGrid12.card-grid{gap:28px}.nx-scope #sportsGrid12 .card{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1/1}}

/* 4-card (2×2) */
.nx-scope .card-grid--4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,125px)}
@media (max-width:700px){.nx-scope .card-grid--4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px}}

/* Duo layout (optional side-by-side carousels) */

<style id="nx-vimeo-inline-css">

.nx-vimeo-facade{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;cursor:pointer;
  background:#15003B center/cover no-repeat;border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden}
.nx-vimeo-facade .nx-vimeo-play {
	position: absolute;
	inset: 0;
	margin: auto;
	width: 92px;
	height: 54px;
	border-radius: 72px;
	background: rgba(140, 245, 133, .92);
	transition: .2s ease;
}
.nx-vimeo-facade:hover .nx-vimeo-play{background:#8CF585;}
.nx-vimeo-facade .nx-vimeo-play::before {
	content: "";
	position: absolute;
	inset: 0;
	margin: auto;
	width: 0;
	height: 0;
	border-style: solid;
	border-width: 12px 0px 12px 22px;
	border-color: transparent transparent transparent #15003B;
	transform: translateX(15%);
	transition: .2s ease;
}
.nx-vimeo-facade:hover .nx-vimeo-play::before {border-left-color:var(--e-global-color-accent);}
.nx-vimeo-facade iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0}
.nx-vimeo-facade:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #8CF585;outline-offset:2px}

<style id="wp-custom-css">
/* Shared Carousel Button Styles */
.nx-btn {
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  cursor: pointer;

  /* default state */
  background: transparent;
  border: 2px solid #8ef585;
  color: #fff; /* arrow is white */
  transition: background .2s ease, color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease, transform .15s ease;
}

/* hover state */
.nx-btn:hover,
.nx-btn:focus-visible {
  background: #8ef585;
  border-color: #8ef585;
  color: #fff; /* arrow stays white */
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.nx-btn:active {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

/* smaller buttons on mobile */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .nx-btn { width: 44px; height: 44px; }
  .nx-btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
}


.nx-scope .nx-carousel,
.nx-scope .nxv-carousel{position:relative;max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;overflow:hidden}
.nx-scope .nx-track,
.nx-scope .nxv-track{display:flex;transition:transform .4s ease;will-change:transform}
.nx-scope .nx-slide,
.nx-scope .nxv-slide{flex:0 0 100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
.nx-scope .nx-media,
.nx-scope .nxv-media{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;display:block;background:#000}
.nx-scope .nx-caption,
.nx-scope .nxv-caption{margin-top:12px;color:#000;font:italic 400 18px/1.35 system-ui;text-align:center}
.nx-scope .nx-controls,
.nx-scope .nxv-controls{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:14px;margin-top:22px}

/* Copy block */
.nx-scope .nx-copy{font-size:22px;line-height:1.5;color:#fff;font-family:system-ui,Arial,sans-serif}
.nx-scope .nx-copy p{margin:0 0 28px}
.nx-scope .nx-copy .nx-green{color:#8ef585;font-weight:700;font-size:25px}

/* Grids */
.nx-scope .align-edges{max-width:1200px;margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:0;box-sizing:border-box}
.nx-scope .card-grid{display:grid;gap:40px;justify-content:center}
.nx-scope .card{
  position:relative;width:125px;height:125px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid #738291;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
  transition:transform .25s, box-shadow .25s, border-color .25s, background .25s;
}
.nx-scope .card img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .3s}
.nx-scope .card:hover,.nx-scope .card:focus-visible{
